state.seed_assertion: Views of individuals or their representatives should be sought and documented unless there is a good reason not to.

sentences.1: Views of individuals or their representatives should be sought and documented unless there is a good reason not to.
sentences.2: You should seek and document the views of individuals (or their representatives) unless there is a good reason not to.
sentences.3: If DPIA decision differs from the views of individuals, the reasons for disregarding their views must be documented.
sentences.4: If your DPIA decision differs from the views of individuals, you need to document your reasons for disregarding their views.
sentences.5: Controllers should seek views of data subjects or their representatives on intended processing when appropriate, without prejudice to protection of commercial interests, public interests or security of operations.
sentences.6: Where appropriate, the controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.
sentences.7: The controller should seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing when appropriate, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.
sentences.8: Where appropriate, the controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.
sentences.9: A schedule for regularly reviewing the DPIA or reviewing it when processing changes should be agreed and documented.
sentences.10: When processing has legal basis in Union law or Member State law that regulates the specific operation and a data protection impact assessment has already been carried out as part of a general impact assessment, the assessment paragraphs do not apply unless the Member State deems it necessary.
sentences.11: Processors may need to assist in the DPIA process by helping understand and document their processing activities and identify associated risks.
sentences.12: Organizations must identify and document measures to eliminate or reduce high risks identified in a DPIA.
